_comment: Shared by syntext-backend (src/services/docs-code) and syntext-cli (src/lib): the custom code rules must give these exact answers in both. Change both copies together.

head.name: review: abrupt comment hides an img
errors: head.html must not contain malformed comments or CDATA
is not allowed (head.html may contain only , ,
head.html may contain only elements (text outside them would start the page body)

head.name: review: meta with slash separator
errors: <meta http-equiv="refresh"> is not allowed

head.name: review: entity-encoded http-equiv
errors: <meta http-equiv="refresh"> is not allowed

head.name: review: script with slash separator
errors: <script src> may load only https:// URLs (found "http://evil.example/x.js")

head.name: review: link onload
errors: <link> must not have event handlers (found onload)

head.name: review: base inside noscript
errors: <base> is not allowed (head.html may contain only <meta>, <link>, <script>, <noscript> and <style>)

head.name: review: style tag inside a script string
errors: <base> is not allowed (head.html may contain only <meta>, <link>, <script>, <noscript> and <style>)

head.name: nested comment
errors: head.html must not contain malformed comments or CDATA

head.name: CDATA
errors: head.html must not contain malformed comments or CDATA
head.html may contain only elements (text outside them would start the page body)

head.name: unknown attribute
errors: <meta> must not have the foo attribute

head.name: http-equiv allowlist
errors: <meta http-equiv="set-cookie"> is not allowed

head.name: text outside elements
errors: head.html may contain only elements (text outside them would start the page body)

head.name: title and base
errors: <title> is not allowed (head.html may contain only <meta>, <link>, <script>, <noscript> and <style>)
<base> is not allowed (head.html may contain only <meta>, <link>, <script>, <noscript> and <style>)

head.name: body breakout
errors: head.html must not contain </head>, <body> or <html>

head.name: style body is CSS
errors: CSS may load only https:// URLs (found "http://x/a.png")

head.name: script body breakout
errors: JavaScript must not contain </head> or </body>

head.name: protocol-relative script
errors: <script src> may load only https:// URLs (found "//cdn.example/x.js")

head.name: script swallowing its own end tag
errors: head.html must not contain malformed comments or CDATA
JavaScript must not contain </script>

head.name: valid head
head.input:
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="description" content="Docs & more">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<script async src="https://plausible.io/js/script.js" data-domain="docs.acme.dev"></script>
<script>window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || []</script>
<noscript><link rel="stylesheet" href="/no-js.css"></noscript>
<style>:root{--stx-color-accent:#f60}</style>
<!-- analytics -->

css.name: review: image-set string

css.name: review: src() function

css.name: review: escaped javascript url
errors: CSS must not contain javascript: or vbscript: URLs
CSS may load only https:// URLs (found "javascript:alert(1)")

css.name: review: escaped expression
errors: CSS must not use expression()

css.name: comment splits a scheme name
errors: CSS must not contain javascript: or vbscript: URLs

css.name: -webkit-image-set
errors: CSS may load only https:// URLs (found "http://b/y.png")

css.name: style breakout
errors: CSS must not contain </style>

js.name: script breakout
errors: JavaScript must not contain </script>

js.name: comment-like text is fine (escaped when injected)
